runs.text: Je suis bien fasché de la brouillerie de Mrs du Parlement avec M. le Comte d'Ognon. Taschez d'accommoder la chose, et de faire en sorte qu'il n'y ayt rien a desmesler entr'eux
toujours de mon affection, et de mon service
J'ay esté fort surpris quand le Sr de Courbay

Prenez soing de tenir tousjours mes amys ... en parfaicte union, et faictes leur bien cognoistre combien elle est necessaire pour leurs affaires et les miennes. Depuis ma lettre escripte la Reyne a mandé le Parlement et les grands du Royaume sur les onze heures de ce matin expres, en presence desquels Elle a fait lire par un secretaire d'Estat un escrit [+]

runs.note: marginal insertion in the gutter between the pages (x~1960-2400, y~1880-1990 px), introduced by '+'; the matching '+' is written under 'le' in the right-page line 'escrit le plus outrageux'; placement here is an interpretation (it also sits level with left line '... psi . 2' which it directly follows on the left)

runs.text: le plus outrageux du monde contre Moy qui a esté
dans lequel elle taxe mon honneur par la mauvaise interpretation qu'elle donne a toutes mes actions
Bien que je ne me mette guere en peine de me justifier a la confusion de mes ennemis des calomnies dont on m'accuse, j'iray pour cet effet demain au Parlement

notes:
Pass B, blind (only page.jpg in passes/B was opened). Bifolium: left page = 19 lines with cipher (incl. one small interlinear line under 'affection...' line, written in smaller hand and read as continuation of the cipher line above), right page = 14 cipher-bearing lines plus long clear paragraphs. Each cipher line read at 2x and 3x zoom; doubtful marks at 4-5x.
SIGN NAMES: SYM:psi = U-shaped curve crossed by a vertical stem with a hook at bottom (very frequent, often looks like a cursive 4). SYM:K = cursive K. SYM:q-barré = 9/q with a horizontal crossbar on the descender. SYM:pi = SHORT pi (wide top bar, two short splayed legs, sits low on the line); SYM:Pi = TALL pi written like 'TT' (two long vertical legs under a bar) - kept apart because the shapes differ consistently; they may be one sign. SYM:w = two-hump omega-like w; SYM:m = three-minim 'ɯ'/'m'-like sign with tail - m vs w distinction moderately reliable. SYM:sigma = used for (a) a circle with a long top stroke curving up to the right, like 'б' (left 'que leur б 42', right line 3 start) and (b) a small circle with a short rising tail to the right (right line 7 '37 σ 56'); the two forms might be different signs. SYM:mars = circle with an arrow-headed stroke up-right (left page '... q ♂ 31 ...'), clearly different from (b). SYM:livre = cursive l/d with a double crossbar on the stem (right page first sign after 'faire scavoir'). SYM:l-cursif = small looped l (right line 1). SYM:8-barré = 8 with a diagonal slash (right, '78 8̸ psi'). SYM:autre-w-a-deux-hampes = 'w'/'ш' with two vertical strokes descending through it, like a doubled psi (left, 'leur б 42 [this] psi 46 41'). SYM:u = u.
MARKS: tilde = wavy stroke; in this hand most bar marks are slightly wavy with a down-hook at the left end, so tilde vs macron is the main systematic uncertainty; only marks that looked clearly straight were given macron (81 and 8 on the right page are clearly straight). acute = short slanted stroke above. caron = small u/v-shaped cup above. diaeresis = two dots, often VERY faint: re-checking showed several 17 (in the recurrent group '17 38 66') carry faint diaeresis while other 17s do not; some other 'none' tokens may hide faint dots. Single digits '1','2' with diaeresis occur (left '69 1̈ 2̈ 35', '54 2̈', 'u 2̈ 47').
PROBLEMS: (1) left line 3 token '29' is under a brown stain - digits legible, any mark hidden (29|none?). (2) Two line-final '2'-shaped hooks were transcribed as token '2|none?': end of left line 14 ('... x psi 2') and right line 2 after clear 'par' ('escrire par 2'); they could be line-end flourishes rather than cipher. (3) Marginal insertion '+ 85 pi 38 68 33 32 / 95' in the gutter between the pages; the matching '+' is under 'le' in the right-page clear line 'escrit + le plus outrageux', so it was placed there as page 'margin'; it physically sits right after left line 14, so it could belong there instead. (4) Right page '15 31 32 48̃' : last sign cramped, read 48 with tilde (48|tilde?). (5) Right page '73' in line '16 18 30 67 73 96' has an ink blot where an acute would be (73|acute?). (6) Accent-like stroke before right '15' attributed to clear word 'esté'. (7) Comma after right line 5 '... 29 26 ,' ignored as punctuation. (8) Left line 1 '48': two faint far-apart specks above, read as no mark (48|none?). Clear text is approximate (anchors only). Long dashes = line fillers, not transcribed.
